fit_semantics: one target-memory build over present-stream Regression Train donors, cycles 56-79; no estimator or preprocessing fit

query_source.classification_test_use: verify ID, cycle_code, and signal_stream one-to-one alignment only; never labels or probabilities

geometry.preprocessor: reuse fitted A02 E75 observed word-TFIDF vectorizer; no refit
geometry.selection_order: descending cosine, then ascending Regression Train source row for ties

prediction.weighted_median_order: residual then source row; equal residual weights grouped
prediction.exact_half_tie: midpoint of adjacent distinct residuals within 1e-12 of total mass
prediction.fallback: exact unchanged R06 prediction when stream missing or positive neighbors <5
